thread:
oliver: FYI customer reported a large invoice delta for vector/rerank usage. Invoice shows 2,403,200 pairwise units billed, dashboard shows ~1,201,600. They used our bulk CSV rerank job. Can someone triage? (ticket #12345)

support-bot: Ticket created: https://tickets.redwood.ai/12345 - ping @maria

maria: assigning to eng infra and billing. @ingrid can you look at metering for pairwise vs single?

ingrid: on it. quick Q: did customer call the rerank endpoint (pairwise) or embed endpoint then do pairwise locally?

oliver: they called /v1/rerank/bulk with CSV -> body indicates pairwise true. sample payload:
```
{ 
  "path": "s3://bucket/rows.csv",
  "mode": "pairwise",
  "batch_size": 512,
  "truncate": true,
  "expected_dim": 1536
}
```

maria: please paste request ids (x-request-id) and invoice line ids.

oliver: request ids: r-77a1, r-77a2, r-77a3. Invoice line: INV-5482. Logs show a retry loop for r-77a2:
```
2026-02-12T14:02:12Z r-77a2 START
2026-02-12T14:02:12Z r-77a2 500 internal
2026-02-12T14:02:14Z r-77a2 RETRY
2026-02-12T14:02:15Z r-77a2 SUCCESS
```

billing: I can confirm invoiced units: 2,403,200 pairwise units for account acct-444. Dashboard metric "embeddings_requests" shows 1,201,600. Our billing table shows meter events emitted on attempt start for the batch shim. Example query:
```
SELECT sum(units) FROM metering.events WHERE account='acct-444' AND meter='pairwise' AND ts >= '2026-02-12';
```

sre: that matches a known edge-case: batch-shim retries can emit meter events on each attempt if idempotency key missing. We rolled a fix for the REST path last quarter but the bulk CSV shim still emits before final ack. Please repro with Idempotency-Key header.

ingrid: repro steps to validate:
1) create minimal CSV with 3 lines.
2) curl:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank/bulk" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
 -H "Idempotency-Key: test-123" -F file=@small.csv -F mode=pairwise
```
3) check metering.events for exactly the expected pairwise units (3 inputs -> 3 pairwise pairs for that small test).

maria: if repro confirms double-metering we'll issue credit and mark as Sev-3. Billing, can you hold credits pending fix?

billing: yes, we'll place provisional credit for INV-5482 until engineering confirms root cause and a patch timeline.

oliver: I'll run the repro with idempotency key and paste results shortly.

oliver: repro done — with Idempotency-Key header we see only a single meter event per submission. Without header we saw two meter events when the server returned 500 then succeeded. attaching small log extract.

maria: great. ingrid, can you prioritize a patch to emit meter events on success only for the bulk-shim? estimate?

ingrid: will add to next sprint and can push a hotfix in 48-72h if needed.

maria: thanks all. billing will follow up on credits and I'll update the customer.

sre: note for follow-up: add automated integration test to bulk-shim that verifies meter emission only after terminal success and that idempotency keys dedupe meter events.

oliver: thanks — closing loop once billing confirms credit. :sparkles:
